thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need to reserve GPUs for the new apac-east1 cluster bring-up next week. Target: 8x A100-80GB + 2x p4-style instances for smoke tests. Can infra procurement kick off quota requests today?

owen: On it. What's the SLA for the bring-up window? Do we need a hard capacity reservation or is quota request + short-term reservation OK?

maria: Need a hard reservation for ~48h during validation. Fallback is smaller instance types if reservation fails but that will increase latency and invalidate perf baselines. Also need a static internal VIP and firewall rules pre-provisioned.

raj: Who's owner for the quota ticket? I can file the cloud quota request but need cost center, start/end times, and any provider-specific keywords (e.g., "capacityReservation").

maria: I'll own it. Cost center: infra-prod-ops. Start: 2026-04-07T08:00Z. End: 2026-04-09T08:00Z. Include request for regional external IPs (2) and a temporary disk IOPS uplift (3TB ephemeral, burst to 200k IOPS).

lina: For validation, please run these checks: kernel modules, NCCL connectivity, nv_peer_mem, MTU 9000 on infra subnet, and a small perf run: `run_perf.sh --model=gpt-small --seq=2048 --tokens=5k`. I'll paste a minimal preflight script below.

sre-bot: Preflight checklist template created at /playbooks/preflight/apac-bringup.md

maria: Owen — can you tag the ticket `apac-bringup-1825` and request the provider for an explicit capacity reservation (if supported) rather than only quota bump? Add a note that we will run a 4-hour smoke test window on the reservation.

owen: Filing now. Drafting message to cloud sales/quotas: 

```
Hello — requesting capacity reservation in apac-east1 for project infra-prod (cost center: infra-prod-ops).
- Resource: a100-80gb (8 instances), p4xlarge-equivalent (2 instances)
- Period: 2026-04-07T08:00Z to 2026-04-09T08:00Z
- Additional: 2 regional IPs, ephemeral disk uplift 3TB with burst IOPS
- Ticket tags: apac-bringup-1825, capacityReservation
Please confirm whether a provider-side reservation token can be issued.
```

raj: Also confirm we have budget covered for on-demand reservation vs spot fallback. If provider supports capacity reservations with a commit discount, include that option in the ask. Also request "preferred-instance=alike" so we get consistent instance types instead of mixed generations.

lina: Networking note: firewall CIDR for the cluster is 10.50.0.0/22. Need networking team to pre-create routes and a 9000 MTU subnet. Also add an SR-IOV check to the preflight.

maria: Good call. Here's a minimal preflight script (run on a control plane VM):

```
# preflight.sh (run as root)
set -e
# basics
sysctl -n net.core.rmem_max || true
# nvidia drivers
modinfo nvidia | head -n 3
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv
# python quick check
python - <<'PY'
import torch
print('cuda', torch.cuda.is_available())
PY
# simple nccl smoke (binary provided in infra-tools)
./nccl_smoke --gpus 8 --msgsize 1MB || exit 2
# network test
iperf3 -c 10.50.0.2 -P 8 -t 10
```

owen: Ticket submitted: #Q-34211 (https://cloud-provider/quotas/Q-34211). Tagged `apac-bringup-1825`. Chose project infra-prod.

raj: I'll ping finance for the 48h reservation approval and attach a short cost delta estimate (on-demand vs reservation vs spot fallback). Lina — can you provide expected perf numbers for the canary so we can set acceptance criteria?

lina: Acceptance criteria (canary): p99 generation latency < 120ms for 4-token micro-batch on the canary model; KV cache warmup within 60s; NCCL all-reduce latency within expected baseline (+/-10%); packet loss < 0.1% on 10Gb links. Also require logging/slow-query traces enabled for the test window.

maria: Once quota/reservation is confirmed we schedule the dry-run on Thu. Owen please send calendar invite to infra-eng, eng-sre, ml-oncall and attach the canary yaml and the preflight script.

owen: Calendar invite sent to infra-eng, eng-sre, ml-oncall. Added canary yaml to ticket and roadmap entry RB-2047.

raj: Two follow-ups: 1) If provider quotas are per-project, we should have a fallback distributing nodes across two projects and use smart routing. 2) Confirm that capacity reservation will reserve GPUs in the same AZs — we prefer single-AZ reservation for lower latency (but multi-AZ fallback is OK).

maria: Agreed. Add fallback plan to runbook: distribute nodes across infra-prod and infra-staging projects and set routing policy to prefer infra-prod endpoints.

lina: After validation, handoff doc will include: acceptance results, perf plots, known issues, and a short runbook for day-1 operations (alerts, autoscaler thresholds, how to tear down reservation).

sre-bot: Reminder: runbook ID assigned RB-2047. Please upload final acceptance results to /artifacts/RB-2047/acceptance.json within 24h of test completion.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll monitor #Q-34211 and post updates. If capacity reservation is denied, we pivot to spot + queueing with scaled-down perf baselines. :thumbsup:
